It introduced the {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Engineer]] skin, rebalanced the [[Toxic Gunner]] and added the Black Friday 2023 sale. This version encompasses five updates, the main v1.9.4 (released 24 November 2023) and four minor updates, the v1.9.4a (released 29 November 2023), v1.9.4b (released 1 December 2023), v1.9.4c (released 2 December 2023), v1.9.4d (released 4 December 2023) and v1.9.4e (released 14 December 2023) ==Additions== *New [[Codes|code]] obtained by purchasing an [[Engineer Plush]] **Code is unique for each [[Engineer Plush]] bought **Gives {{Color|Other|Plushie}} [[Engineer]] skin ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Toxic Gunner]] buffed. **Statistical changes: ***'''Base''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|675}}. ****Firerate decreased from 0.175 to 0.15. ****Burst increased from 3 to 6. ***'''Level 1''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|150}} to {{Money|200}}. ***'''Level 2''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|400}} to {{Money|750}}. ****Poison damage increased from 1 to 2. ****Poison time increased from 2 to 6. ****Slowdown time increased from 2 to 6. ****Now melts defense by 1% every tick. ***'''Level 3''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|1,600}} to {{Money|3,000}}. ****Firerate changed from {{Tooltip|0.175 > 0.125|-0.05}} to {{Tooltip|0.15 > 0.125|-0.025}}. ****Poison damage increased from +0 to +1. ****Burst increased from 3 > 6 to 6 > 10. ****Name changed from ''Hazardous Gear'' to ''Sinister Gear''. ***'''Level 4''' ****Cost increased from {{Money|6,000}} to {{Money|9,250}}. ****Poison damage increased from +0 to +2. ****Burst count changed from 6 > 10 to 10. ****Cooldown changed from 0.5 to 0.5 > 0. ****Poison time increased from 5 to 10. ****Slowdown time increased from 5 to 10. ****Name changed from ''Nuclear Overload'' to ''Going Nuclear!''. *Fixed [[Jester]]'s poisonous puddles not generating cash. *[[The Great Finale]] changed. **[[Spotlight]]
